title: McCarthy–Osburn–Straub Conjecture 1.3 for σ₈, with a shifted companion
abstract: Let A(n) be the sum, over k ∈ [0, n]^4 with k₁ + k₂ = k₃ + k₄, of the products Π C(n, k_i) C(n + k_i, k_i). The package proves A(mp^r) ≡ A(mp^{r−1}) (mod p^{3r}) and A(mp^r − 1) ≡ A(mp^{r−1} − 1) (mod p^{3r}) for every prime p ≥ 5 and all m, r ≥ 1. By McCarthy, Osburn and Straub's Proposition 3.1, A(n) is the leading coefficient of Brown's cellular integral for σ₈ = (8, 3, 6, 1, 4, 7, 2, 5), so the first congruence is their Conjecture 1.3 for σ₈. That link is not formalized. The second congruence is a companion that no source states. σ₈ is the self-dual configuration that MOS single out: their Theorem 1.2 relates A_σ₈((p − 1)/2) to the weight-6 newform η¹²(2z) modulo p².
